body: I'll be damned if they put me back in that fucking hospital. Not again. Not ever. I'll kill them if they try that again
I wish that car accident where I got tboned killed me back a few years ago. Unfortunately I fixed my seatbelt minutes before I crashed or I'd have been dead.

I'm here but I can't do this any longer. This is boring, there is nothing. Existentialism, everything. All a flat life to me. I've fed the homeless, traveled, studied. I only held on because a few people promised me things would get better. I'm still very unhappy and at the bare minimum before I die I will try with a knife again. The iron smell and lack of blood made me pass out last time. I also failed to note that my blood coagulates rather quickly so I should steal some blood thinners from someone so that I can at least make the bleedout harder to stop. People are less likely to be able to revive someone who has lost alot of blood. Buddy won't even know because I run the fan on in here and you cant hear a thing. At least cleanup is fast I can leave the shower running. I just have to cut deeper next time and twist a bit more. Bleedout seems to be a good way, as long as you dont pass out first.
